SELECT `c`.`Id` AS `CustomerId`, `c`.`KodeCustomer`, `c`.`NamaCustomer`, `c`.`Email`, `c`.`NoTelepon`, (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM `PenugasanAsets` AS `p`
    INNER JOIN `penugasanasetdetail` AS `p0` ON `p`.`Id` = `p0`.`PenugasanAsetId`
    WHERE (`p`.`TargetPenerimaId` = `c`.`Id`) AND `p`.`TanggalPengembalian` IS NULL) AS `JumlahAsetAktif`
FROM `Customers` AS `c`
ORDER BY `c`.`KodeCustomer`
LIMIT @__p_1 OFFSET @__p_0
